messages:
Renee: quick weekly check for Nimbus — summary bullets: WoW tokens +16%, QoQ +39%. Billing trend +10% WoW. p95 latency +28ms (now ~410ms). Error rate ~4.3% (mostly 429s).
Omar: good to know. Any concentrated hotspots (route/key)?
Renee: yes "/v1/generate" is ~64% of token volume. Two keys own most traffic: nimbus-main and nimbus-batcher. Spike window yesterday 12:05-12:33 UTC.
metrics-bot: [ALERT] acct_nimbus - 5m 429 rate = 4.7% (threshold 3.5%). Dashboard: https://dd.example.com/d/nimbus/alerts
Diego: I pulled the traces 1 - KV cache hit rate drops when concurrent streams > 6. Clients seem to open many short-lived streams.
Priya: did they change model defaults? QoQ token jump suggests feature rollout.
Renee: they enabled a new "daily-recap" feature last month and switched some routes to rdx-3-small.
Omar: rdx-3-small explains higher CPU and latency. Short-term fixes: 1) recommend client concurrency cap (3-4), 2) enable prefix cache for long prompts, 3) route non-critical rerank to rdx-2-medium.
Priya: I'll draft a Python SDK snippet to share with their engineers:
```
# client: reduce concurrency, enable batching
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(concurrency=3, batch_window_ms=30, enable_prefix_cache=True)
```
Diego: I also ran a quick telemetry slice to show token distribution by hour and route:
```
SELECT FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y-%m-%d %H', event_time) as hour, route, SUM(tokens) as tokens
FROM `redwood.telemetry.events`
WHERE account_id='acct_nimbus' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
GROUP BY hour, route
ORDER BY hour DESC, tokens DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
Diego: top: /v1/generate = 64% tokens, /v1/rerank = 18%, embeddings ~9%. Key nimbus-main = 70% of calls.
Renee: action plan: Omar -> send client-side config guidance to CSM; Priya -> SDK note + short how-to; Diego -> attach telemetry heatmaps and traces; Renee -> prepare enablement invite.
Omar: suggest scheduling 30m enablement: Fri 15:00 UTC or Mon 09:00 UTC. Which is better?
Renee: propose Fri 15:00 UTC. We'll include dev advocate and AE.
Priya: I'll prepare a 10-slide deck: batching, prefix caching, model routing, and sample cost impact.
Diego: I'll model two scenarios for the AE: A) rerank -> rdx-2-medium for non-critical traffic (projected ~20% monthly savings), B) keep rdx-3-small + enforce batching/caching (projected ~12% savings with lower latency).
Renee: flagged renewal risk if spend/latency trend continues. AE wants numbers before renewal planning.
Omar: I'll coordinate with AE once Diego posts the cost deltas.
Renee: I'll update ticket RED-4321 with telemetry links and assign tasks. Will reopen if error rate exceeds 6% before the session. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
